What the Tiers Mean

Response Time Promise by Tier

Roubic's tier system is honest about where our crew can be, when. Closer cities get faster response. Every tier still gets the same Aaron-walks-your-property estimate + confirmed pricing.

1Tier

Priority Response

Priority estimate · 1–2 hour emergency Fastest response tier
  • Business-hours estimate scheduled priority
  • 1–2 hour after-hours storm response
  • Village permits filed in-house
  • 10–20 min drive from Auburn Twp yard
Example Cities Auburn Township · Pepper Pike · Chagrin Falls · Moreland Hills · Solon
2Tier

2-Day Response

2-day estimate · 2–4 hour emergency Standard scheduling tier
  • Estimate scheduled within 2 business days
  • 2–4 hour after-hours storm response
  • Village permits handled where required
  • 20–30 min drive from Auburn Twp yard
Example Cities Gates Mills · Beachwood · Orange · Bainbridge Twp · Shaker Heights
3Tier

2-3 Day Response

2–3 day estimate · varies by proximity Outer service radius tier

  • After-hours response varies by proximity

  • 30–40 min drive from Auburn Twp yard

Common Service Area Questions

Service Areas FAQ

Five things NE Ohio homeowners want to know about our coverage.

Why is Roubic's service radius 40 miles?
40 miles is the practical limit for priority estimate turnaround with our Auburn Township yard as origin. Beyond that, drive time cuts into on-site work and makes emergency response impossible to guarantee. Aaron reviews out-of-radius requests case-by-case — storm response and larger commercial jobs sometimes justify the trip.
How much faster is Tier 1 than Tier 3?
Tier 1 (Auburn Twp HQ, Pepper Pike, Chagrin Falls, Moreland Hills, Solon) gets priority estimate scheduling and 1–2 hour after-hours emergency response. Tier 3 (Chesterland, Mayfield, South Russell) gets 2–3 day estimate scheduling. The removal work itself is identical — same crew, same equipment, same pricing.
Can Roubic still handle my job if I'm outside the 40-mile radius?
Sometimes. Aaron reviews out-of-radius requests case-by-case. Storm response after major weather events (multi-tree failures, tree-on-structure) and larger commercial jobs (5+ trees, multi-property HOAs) can justify the extended drive. Call {{global.phone}} and describe the situation — Aaron will tell you whether it fits.
Are commercial jobs handled differently across the tiers?
Response scheduling still follows tier rules, but commercial pricing is quoted based on scope and access rather than tier. Property managers, HOAs, and commercial buildings get a Certificate of Insurance on request and the same insurance-documentation packet on storm work regardless of city.
Does Roubic bring a crane to every city?
Crane access is available across all 13 cities when the job requires it — very-large trees (80+ ft), tree-on-structure work, or restricted-access removals. Crane deployment adds to the job cost and requires slightly longer scheduling in Tier 2/3 cities to coordinate with the crane operator. Confirmed during the free estimate walk.
